correctness.rationale: Read actual RESULT.md, check.py, REVIEW.md and VERIFICATION.md from assigned Git blob SHAs. The fixed-u target-value slice is an ordinary disk of center (1-q)u/(1-q|u|²) and radius sqrt(q)(1-|u|²)/(1-q|u|²); polar Fubini gives V=π²qJ0 and Iu=π²qJ1. Balanced-domain evaluation K(0,0)=1/V and simultaneous Möbius covariance give diagonal K(a,a)=1/[V(1-|a|²)^4]. Degree-one rotational orthogonality and exchange symmetry diagonalize in s=u+v,d=u-v; the diagonal kernel |a|² coefficient forces ||s||²=V, while ||d||²=4Iu−V, yielding exact eigenvalues. M=J1/J0 increases strictly since its derivative is the positive covariance of t and 2t/(1-qt). The rational-logarithmic J0,J1 forms give both endpoint coefficients. Independent high-precision quadratures and exact small-q coefficient checked four q values; they support but do not prove all parameters. Normalization is Euclidean unweighted volume and metric ∂∂bar log K, only diagonal points.

value.rationale: Nevanlinna–Pick target domains are natural complex domains; intrinsic normal-versus-tangential Bergman metric is an important analytic-geometric invariant. The exact monotone deformation and unequal algebraic and logarithmic degeneration rates quantify node collision and recovery of bidisk geometry for the entire two-node family, not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice.

final_claim: For 0<rho<1 and each a in the disk, the Bergman metric on the two-node target Pick domain has eigendirections (1,±1)/sqrt(2), eigenvalues 2/(1-|a|²)² and 2J0/(4J1−J0)/(1-|a|²)², with ratio strictly decreasing, 10/(3rho²)+O(1) as rho→0, and 1+4(1-rho²)log(1/(1-rho²))+O(1-rho²) as rho→1.
limitations: Only two-node unit disk Pick targets and their diagonal metric; no off-diagonal Bergman tensor, curvature, multi-node Pick body or weighted metric.
